defs.def: to need sth; to depend on sb/sth 需要；依靠；依赖

ex.s: SoFi Stadium requires you to park strictly in your assigned zone, and guests must enter through the exact gate indicated on their color-coded digital parking pass.
ex.t: SoFi体育场要求你严格在指定区域停车，并且宾客必须通过其彩色编码电子停车证上标明的确切入口进入。

ex.s: Prior to SLEAP, tracking the physical characteristics of both plants and animals required a lot of labor that slowed the scientific process.
ex.t: 在SLEAP出现之前，追踪动植物物理特征需要大量人工，拖慢了科研进程。

ex.s: Groups of five or more require special arrangements and must be confirmed in advance.
ex.t: 五人及以上的团体需要特别安排，并须提前确认。

ex.s: The benefits of print reading particularly shine through when experimenters move from posing simple tasks — like identifying the main idea in a reading passage — to ones that require mental abstraction — such as drawing inferences from a text.
ex.t: 当实验者从简单任务——比如找出一段阅读材料的主旨——转向需要心智抽象的任务——比如从文本中做推断——时，纸质阅读的优势尤为明显。

ex.s: This mountain walk provides an insight into the skills required for hillwalking to ensure you get the most from future walking trips.
ex.t: 这场山间漫步让您深入了解山间漫步所需的技能，以确保您从未来的徒步之旅中获得最大收益。

ex.s: What are participants in Walk 3 required to do?
ex.t: 路线3的参加者需要做什么？

ex.s: The innovative design requires little effort to achieve a reliable weekly supply of fresh greens.
ex.t: 这一创新设计只需很少的投入，就能实现稳定的每周新鲜蔬菜供应。

ex.s: It requires day-to-day care.
ex.t: 它需要日常照料。

ex.s: The thing is, regular exercise to get “in shape” requires constant and considerable effort — all for gradual progress and uncertain rewards.
ex.t: 问题是，为『塑形』而进行的规律锻炼需要持续且大量的努力——而这一切只是为了渐进的进步和不确定的回报。

ex.s: Trying doesn’t require a lot of trying.
ex.t: 尝试并不需要费很大力气去"试"。

ex.s: This process requires you to step away from optional online activities for thirty days.
ex.t: 这个过程要求你远离可选的线上活动三十天。

ex.s: In more technical terms, the wisdom of crowds requires that people’s estimates be independent.
ex.t: 用更专业的术语来说，群体智慧要求人们的估算相互独立。

ex.s: Which kind of music are the young players required to play?
ex.t: 年轻选手被要求演奏哪种音乐？

ex.s: Which kind of music are the young players required to play?
ex.t: 年轻选手被要求演奏哪种音乐？

ex.s: Before starting any position, all students need to complete required taforms and show identification.
ex.t: 在开始任何职位之前，所有学生需要完成必要的表格并出示身份证件。

ex.s: If, at a later date, you wish to apply for a job or graduate school where an official copy of your UCLA record is required, it will be to your advantage to provide an impressive academic record.
ex.t: 如果在以后的日子里，你申请的工作或研究生院需要你的加州大学洛杉矶分校成绩单的正式副本，那么提供一份令人印象深刻的学业记录将对你有好处。

ex.s: Participation in a post-visit survey is required.
ex.t: 需要参与访后调查。

ex.s: "Big change requires big ideas." he said in a speech last month, referring broadly to the need to improve road safety.
ex.t: "大变革需要大构想，"他在上个月的一次演讲中说，泛指改善道路安全的需要。

ex.s: Simpler jobs require greater caution.
ex.t: 简单的工作需要更加谨慎。

ex.s: After all, nature does not require our patience, but our action.
ex.t: 毕竟，自然不需要我们的耐心，而是需要我们的行动。

ex.s: Many fish perform suction feeding that requires specialised body parts to quickly generate air pressure that can draw nearby food into their mouths.
ex.t: 许多鱼类进行吸食式进食，这需要特殊的身体部位快速产生气压，将附近的食物吸入嘴里。

ex.s: The force required to break the pancake was less than 1% of the trunk’s weight (about 100kg).
ex.t: 掰开那块“煎饼”所需的力小于树干重量（约100公斤）的1%。

ex.s: The staff is friendly and helpful, providing you with a map of the city when you arrive, and offering advice if you require some.
ex.t: 工作人员是友好和有帮助的，为您提供到达时的城市地图，如果您需要一些建议，也会提供建议。

ex.s: Being a page turner requires plenty of practice.
ex.t: 做一名翻谱员需要大量练习。

ex.s: Some pieces of music can go for 40 minutes and require up to 50 page turns, including back turns for repeat passages.
ex.t: 一些音乐片段可以进行40分钟，需要长达50页的翻转，包括重复段落的回转。

ex.s: Advance bookings are required(info@middletonlodge.co.uk.paris)
ex.t: 需要提前预订（info@middletonlodge.co.uk.paris）。

ex.s: Things quickly got very intense due to the huge amount of energy required to look after them.
ex.t: 由于照顾它们需要耗费巨大的精力，一切很快就变得十分紧张忙碌。

ex.s: 34   So a common language is required and in postcrossing that’s English since it’s widely spoken.
ex.t: 34   因此需要一种通用语言，而在明信片交流中这种语言就是英语，因为它被广泛使用。

ex.s: Which job requires a driver's license?
ex.t: 哪份工作需要驾照？

ex.s: "It requires creativity on the part of the technologist, imagination, a lot of patience and kindness."
ex.t: “这需要技师发挥创造力、想象力，以及极大的耐心与善意。”

ex.s: Challenging work that requires lots of analytical thinking, planning and other managerial skills might help your brain stay sharp as you age, a study published Wednesday in the journal Neurology suggests.
ex.t: 周三发表在《神经学》期刊上的一项研究表明，需要大量分析思考、规划和其他管理技能的富有挑战性的工作，可能有助于你的大脑随着年龄增长保持敏锐。

ex.s: A waiter’s job, for example, that requires multitasking, teamwork and decision-making could be just as stimulating as any high-level office work.
ex.t: 例如，服务员的工作需要多任务处理、团队合作和决策，可能和任何高级办公室工作一样具有刺激性。

ex.s: He was required to learn the skill during his internship.
ex.t: 他在实习期间被要求学习这项技能。

ex.s: Devotion requires enthusiasm.
ex.t: 投入需要热情。

ex.s: Some positions require students to be 15 to 24 or up to 29 for persons with a disability.
ex.t: 有些岗位要求学生年龄在15至24岁，残障人士可放宽至29岁。

ex.s: It requires no training before employment.
ex.t: 就业前不需要培训。

ex.s: What is the age range required by Stewardship Youth Ranger Program?
ex.t: 资源管理员青年护林员项目要求的年龄范围是多少？

ex.s: It also doesn't require a new type of technology that people aren't already familiar with.
ex.t: 它也不需要人们尚不熟悉的新技术。

ex.s: January 5 Submit a topic proposal to your history teacher． The teacher may require a second proposal if the first is off﹣topic or unclear．
ex.t: 1月5日 向你的历史老师提交一个主题提案。如果第一个提案偏题或不清晰，老师可能要求提交第二个。

ex.s: An A-team may require a balance-not just A players，but a few generous B players as well.
ex.t: 50     。一支A队可能需要平衡——不仅有A级球员，也要有几个乐于奉献的B级球员。

ex.s: They require a bigger commitment than smaller ones, and they have a more powerful effect on the feeling of a space.
ex.t: 它们比小面积选择需要更大的投入，并对空间氛围有更强的影响。

ex.s: Among the bag makers' argument: many cities with bans still allow shoppers to purchase paper bags, which are easily recycled but require more energy to produce and transport.
ex.t: 在塑料袋生产商的说法中还提到：许多实施禁令的城市仍允许购物者购买纸袋，纸袋易于回收，但生产和运输耗能更多。

ex.s: Producing them requires more energy.
ex.t: 塑料、纸张还是两者都不是

ex.s: Relearning the art of seeing the world around us is quite simple, although it takes practice and requires breaking some bad habits．
ex.t: 重新学习观察周围世界的艺术其实很简单，尽管需要练习，还需要改掉一些坏习惯。

ex.s: In the case of emperors, the act required the person to touch their head to the ground.
ex.t: 在皇帝的情况下，该礼节要求人把头触地。

ex.s: He said that was all they were required to do for their own king.
ex.t: 今天，这种用法与中国没有任何关系，也没有任何特定的政治联系。

ex.s: They should emphasize these skills when applying for jobs that require the ability to multitask.
ex.t: 申请人的简历列出任何涉及团队合作和目标导向责任的活动很重要。

ex.s: In my first P.E. class, the teacher required us to run laps and then hit a softball.
ex.t: 在我的第一节体育课上，老师要求我们跑步，然后打垒球。

ex.s: The only components required, though, are a 5'×5' sheet of clear or slightly milky plastic, six feet of plastic tube, and a container — perhaps just a drinking cup — to catch the water.
ex.t: 不过唯一需要的部件是一张5×5英尺的透明或微乳白塑料布、六英尺塑料管，以及一个容器——或许就一个喝水杯——来接水。

ex.s: They are required    63    (process) the food that we eat, to recover from injury and for several other bodily functions.
ex.t: 它们是____（处理）我们所吃的食物、从伤病中恢复以及其他多种身体功能所必需的。

ex.s: Advance reservations required.
ex.t: 需要提前预订。

ex.s: What are tourists required to do to go on Holiday Lights Tour?
ex.t: 游客参加节日灯光之旅需要做什么？

ex.s: The Moldovan has lived here seven years as a caregiver to Italian kids and the elderly, but in order to stay she’s had to prove her language skills by taking a test which requires her to write a postcard to an imaginary friend and answer a fictional job ad.
ex.t: 这位摩尔多瓦人作为意大利孩子和老人的照护者已在这里住了七年，但为了留下来，她必须通过一项测试来证明自己的语言能力——测试要求她给一个想象中的朋友写明信片，并回复一则虚构的招聘广告。

ex.s: ● If your news station or school requires interviewees to sign release forms to appear on the air, don’t leave work without them.
ex.t: ● 如果你的新闻台或学校要求受访者在出镜前签署免责声明表格，没有完成这项工作就不要离开。

ex.s: But other books require a bit more work on your part
ex.t: 但其他书需要你多花点功夫

ex.s: A rethink is required — and as a new approach starts to become apparent, two ideas stand out.
ex.t: 需要重新思考——随着一种新的方法开始显现，有两个观点脱颖而出。

ex.s: Job requirements Being a wildlife photographer requires good photography skills, knowledge of animal behaviour and a lot of patience.
ex.t: 工作要求作为一名野生动物摄影师，需要具备良好的摄影技巧、动物行为知识和充足的耐心。

ex.s: He used donated funds and his own money to pay the 50 pounds per child that the British government required.
ex.t: 他用捐赠的资金和自己的钱来支付英国政府要求的每个孩子50英镑的费用。

ex.s: A 2016 study said 17 states of the US require high school students to take courses in personal finances.
ex.t: 2016年的一项研究指出，美国有17个州要求高中生修读个人理财课程。

ex.s: However, sending people there will require all the skill, courage and intelligence of the human race.
ex.t: 但是，派人去那里需要人类所有的技能、勇气和智慧。

ex.s: This requires commitment to a particular occupation, branch of study or research.
ex.t: 这需要对某一特定职业、学科或研究领域的投入。

ex.s: However, longer-lasting reusable bags often require more energy to make.
ex.t: 一项研究发现，一个棉布袋必须至少使用131次才能比塑料袋更有利于环境。

ex.s: According to systems thinking, changing the food system—or any other network—requires three things to happen.
ex.t: 根据系统思维，改变食物系统——或任何其他网络——需要三件事情发生。

defs.def: to make sb do or have sth, especially because it is necessary according to a particular law or set of rules 使做（某事）；使拥有（某物）；（尤指根据法规）规定

ex.s: Studies have shown that it calculates the effort required for actions and tends to stop us from squandering vital resources on fruitless efforts, like walking over 30 km for a handful of berries.
ex.t: 研究表明，它会计算某项行动所需的努力，并倾向于阻止我们把宝贵的资源浪费在徒劳的努力上，比如走30多公里只为摘一把浆果。

ex.s: UNESCO awarded Shennongjia this status because it meets two criteria required by the list.
ex.t: 联合国教科文组织授予神农架这一地位，因为它符合该名录所要求的两项标准。
